title: Issue with medtronic "Last bolus" value
body:
I'm using version 3.4.0.0 and noticed an issue if the time elapsed since my last bolus runs ino hours instead of minutes the MDT tab shows "FAILED to get string hoursago" beside "Last Bolus".

I've attached images showign the error as well as images showing the display immediately after a bolus and after a minute has elapsed.

comments.body: I think this was already fixed in dev version (in January)...
That would be great. It isn't a show stopper by any means so happy to wait for a future release.
